context_for_next_testing_agent: Density image-generation flow is fully working both sides. Project-id field-shape fix is verified. If the user reports any further issue with density apply, first check whether the slide already had textual elements (the apply only generates the layout split when textualEls.length > 0). The endpoint POST /api/density/generate-image is idempotent on (projectId, suggestionId) so retries are cheap. Existing pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_density_generate_image.py still covers the backend.
rca of the issue: Iteration_121 bug (frontend never called /api/density/generate-image) was caused by SlideProperties.jsx reading `project?.projectId` while the parent Editor.jsx passed `currentProject` whose id field is `.id`. The truthy guard `project?.projectId` evaluated to undefined and the fetch never fired. The fix (line 347) uses `project?.id || project?.projectId` to support both prop shapes (editor flow + agent flow). E2E network capture in this iteration confirms exactly ONE POST to /api/density/generate-image, returning 200 with the expected JSON, and the canvas updates with text+image split as designed.
